title: Avalanche Gamma Sweep (0.1, 0.5, 1.0)

interpretation.sensitivity: Traces show minimal separation across gamma=0.1-1.0 in current timescale/frequency regime, suggesting damping is small relative to driving frequencies.
interpretation.convergence: All runs converge to similar final states, indicating regime is below critical decoherence threshold.
interpretation.future_exploration: Longer horizons (t_end=5e-12 to 1e-11) or stronger damping (gamma=1-10) recommended for clearer separation.
interpretation.physical_insight: Current parameter space models subcritical stress; avalanche dynamics dominated by coherent oscillations rather than dissipation.

validation.solver_consistency: mcsolve used for all runs (mesolve overflow)

next_steps: Extended timescale sweep (1e-11 to 1e-9 s) for dissipation dominance
Higher gamma regime (5-10) for pathological stress modeling
Multi-column scaling (5-10 columns) for larger avalanche networks
